title: The evaluation map identifies R-Hom(L,M) tensor K with R-Hom(R-Hom(K,L), M) for perfect K

difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for perfect K the evaluation comparison map R-Hom(L, M) tensor K -> R-Hom(R-Hom(K, L), M) is an isomorphism. The proof first reduces locally on X, because both sides commute with localization, so that K may be assumed strictly perfect; it then checks compatibility with distinguished triangles in K, which reduces the statement to the case of a single finite free module (proof lines 12889-12930). H2: the reduction through localization and the triangle argument to the free case is the substance, and it is a complete derivation rather than a citation.
